errors.text_span: In panel (c), DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B (97.3) exceeds the performance of Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct (95.2)
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence misidentifies two models in panel (c). The model with a score of 97.3 is DeepSeek-R1, not DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B. The model with a score of 95.2 is DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B, not Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct (which does not appear in this panel).
In panel (d), the model with a score of 9.3 is GPT-4o, not o1-mini.
In panel (e), the scores for these two models are swapped. DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B has a score of 63.3, and o1-mini has a score of 63.6.

errors.text_span: The results collectively suggest that smaller LLMs employing TTS can achieve superior performance compared to larger models using CoT, particularly on these challenging mathematical reasoning tasks.
errors.evidence: This final sentence provides a conclusion and interpretation of the data's meaning, which goes beyond a neutral, descriptive summary of the figure's contents.
